scenario: 面试官问：一个新的内容审核模型上线前，你怎么拿到训练标签？他想看你把「打标签」当成系统而不是一句预处理带过。
scenario_en: Interview: how do you get training labels for a new content-moderation model? They want to see you treat labeling as a system, not a one-line preprocessing step.
q: 该用什么心智模型来谈「打标签」？
q_en: What mental model should frame how you talk about labeling?
why: 把标注当成一条有成本预算、质量监控、反馈回路的流水线，核心张力是质量 vs 成本 vs 延迟 vs 规模——Uber 欺诈的 ground truth 要等几天、专家标注每小时上百美元，但模型现在就要标签。只谈「找人标一下」会漏掉这条主线。
why_en: Treat labeling as a pipeline with cost budgets, quality monitoring, and feedback loops whose core tension is quality vs cost vs latency vs scale.
tradeoff: 标注质量 vs 成本 vs 延迟 vs 规模——四者不可兼得
diagram:
flowchart LR
  U["未标注数据池"] --> S{"选标注策略"}
  S --> H["人工/众包"]
  S --> W["弱监督"]
  S --> P["自/半监督"]
  H --> L["带质量监控的标签"]
  W --> L
  P --> L
  L --> M["训练模型"]
options: 当成一次性的数据预处理：找人把数据标完、交给模型，之后基本不用再管这套流程
当成有成本预算、质量监控和反馈回路的流水线，核心张力是质量 vs 成本 vs 延迟 vs 规模
当成纯建模问题：只要模型够强，标签噪声和标注成本都能被架构自动吸收，不必单独设计
当成一次性众包采购：把数据全丢给 MTurk，价低者得，质量和一致性不是系统要操心的事
options_en: As one-off preprocessing: get the data labeled once, hand it to the model, and mostly forget the process afterward.
As a pipeline with cost budgets, quality monitoring, and feedback loops whose core tension is quality vs cost vs latency vs scale.
As a pure modeling problem: a strong enough model absorbs label noise and cost automatically, so labeling needs no separate design.
As a one-off crowdsourcing purchase: dump all data on MTurk at the lowest bid; quality and consistency are not the system's concern.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务的标签能由确定性规则或已有系统自动产出（如日志里的成交/退款事件），标注确实退化成一次性预处理，不需要这套反馈回路。
optionExplanations: 一次性预处理漏掉了持续监控和反馈：分布一漂、标注质量掉，没有回路就发现不了，模型悄悄退化。
对；把四个约束摆上台面，才谈得清为什么某任务选弱监督、某任务必须上专家，这是这一章的主线。
把成本和噪声甩给模型是幻想：asymmetric 噪声会系统性移动决策边界，再强的架构也救不回来。
只比价不管一致性，会灌进大量分歧标签，Cohen's kappa 低到 reward/分类信号都不可信。
optionExplanations_en: One-off preprocessing skips continuous monitoring and feedback: when the distribution shifts and label quality drops, no loop catches it and the model silently degrades.
Correct — naming the four constraints is what lets you argue why one task picks weak supervision and another needs experts; it is the through-line of the chapter.
Offloading cost and noise to the model is wishful: asymmetric noise systematically moves the decision boundary and no architecture recovers it.
Bidding on price alone ignores consistency, flooding you with disagreeing labels and Cohen's kappa so low the signal is untrustworthy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被当作正确答案的参考标签，是训练和评估的基准。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ground truth is the label treated as correct, serving as the basis for training and evaluation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 亚马逊的众包平台，把小任务分发给大量匿名工人标注。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MTurk (Amazon Mechanical Turk) is a crowdsourcing platform that farms small tasks out to many anonymous workers.

scenario: 要搭一条人工标注流水线，给一批审核样本打标签，目标是稳定、可监控的高质量标签。
scenario_en: You are building a human annotation pipeline to label a batch of moderation samples, aiming for stable, monitorable, high-quality labels.
q: 人在环（human-in-the-loop）标注流水线包含哪些耦合组件？(多选)
q_en: Which coupled components make up a human-in-the-loop annotation pipeline? (multiple)
why: 人在环把几个组件耦合起来：低歧义的任务界面设计、按专长选标注者、用 Cohen's kappa 量一致性、分歧走仲裁、注入 gold-standard 已知标签样例做质控。核心取舍是标注质量 vs 速度——纯人工扩不上去。
why_en: A human-in-the-loop pipeline couples task design, annotator selection, agreement measurement, adjudication, and gold-standard quality control, trading quality against velocity.
options: 任务设计：低歧义的标注界面，附类别定义和边界（edge-case）示例
标注者选择：按领域专长匹配（医学影像找放射科医生，审核用众包）
质量控制：注入已知标签的 gold-standard 样例，实时监控每个标注者的准确率
用更大的模型直接替代人工标注，从此不再需要任何人类判断
options_en: Task design: a low-ambiguity labeling interface with category definitions and edge-case examples.
Annotator selection: match domain expertise (radiologists for medical imaging, crowd for moderation).
Quality control: inject gold-standard examples with known labels to monitor each annotator's accuracy in real time.
Replace human annotation with a bigger model, eliminating the need for any human judgment.
optionExplanations: 对；界面歧义大，标注者各按各的理解走，一致性直接崩，所以任务设计是第一道闸。
对；专长不匹配的人给不出可信标签，放射影像交给众包就是灾难，选人决定标签上限。
对；不掺 gold-standard 就无从知道谁在乱标，注入已知答案是唯一能在线量准确率的手段。
错；这一章讲的正是人工无法独自扩展、需要弱监督/半监督来补，但不是「用大模型取消人类判断」——那会丢掉建立 ground truth 的锚。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — an ambiguous interface lets annotators follow their own reading, collapsing agreement, so task design is the first gate.
Correct — a mismatched annotator cannot give trustworthy labels; handing radiology to the crowd is a disaster, so selection caps label quality.
Correct — without gold-standard mixed in you cannot tell who is mislabeling; injecting known answers is the only way to measure accuracy online.
Wrong — the chapter's point is that humans cannot scale alone and need weak/semi-supervision to help, not that a big model removes human judgment, which would drop the ground-truth anchor.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让人类参与标注、审核、纠错的闭环流程，是标注质量的黄金标准。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Human-in-the-loop keeps people in the labeling and review loop, the gold standard for label quality.

termDefinitions.meaning: 已知正确标签的样例，混进任务里暗中考核标注者准确率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Gold-standard examples have known correct labels and are seeded into tasks to covertly audit annotator accuracy.

scenario: 同一批审核样本给多个标注者打，想量化他们打得一致不一致，一致性太低就说明标注指南有问题。
scenario_en: The same moderation samples are labeled by multiple annotators; you want to quantify how much they agree, and low agreement flags a broken guideline.
q: 该用什么指标量标注者一致性，指标偏低意味着什么动作？
q_en: What metric measures inter-annotator agreement, and what does a low value trigger?
why: 用 Cohen's kappa 量一致性，它扣除了「靠运气碰巧一致」的部分，比裸重合率可信。kappa 低于阈值说明任务定义模糊，动作是回去修标注指南、补边界案例，而不是硬训模型。
why_en: Use Cohen's kappa, which corrects for chance agreement; a below-threshold value means the task is ambiguous, so revise the guidelines rather than train on noisy labels.
options: 用裸重合率（两人标签相同的比例）即可，越高越好，不必扣除碰巧一致的部分
用 Cohen's kappa 量一致性；低于阈值说明任务歧义大，动作是回去修订标注指南
用模型在验证集上的准确率代替一致性指标，标注者之间是否一致无所谓
用标注总条数衡量：标得越多质量越高，一致性可以等数据量够了自然变好
options_en: Just use raw overlap (fraction where two annotators match) — higher is better, no need to correct for chance agreement.
Use Cohen's kappa for agreement; below threshold means the task is ambiguous, so go revise the labeling guidelines.
Use the model's validation accuracy in place of an agreement metric; whether annotators agree does not matter.
Use total label count: more labels means higher quality, and agreement improves on its own once you have enough data.
optionExplanations: 裸重合率会把「两人都瞎猜也可能撞对」算进去，稀有类别下虚高，kappa 正是为扣掉这部分而生。
对；kappa 扣除机遇一致，低分是指南模糊的信号，先修任务定义再谈标签质量。
模型准确率是下游结果，掩盖不了上游标签打得乱；一致性必须在标注环节独立量。
堆量不解决系统性分歧，指南不清时标越多噪声越多，kappa 不会因量大自动变好。
optionExplanations_en: Raw overlap counts cases where both guessed and happened to match; it inflates for rare classes, which is exactly why kappa subtracts chance.
Correct — kappa removes chance agreement, and a low score signals ambiguous guidelines, so fix the task definition before trusting labels.
Model accuracy is a downstream result that hides messy upstream labels; agreement must be measured independently at the labeling stage.
Piling on volume does not fix systematic disagreement; with unclear guidelines more labels means more noise, and kappa does not self-heal with scale.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量两个标注者一致性的统计量，扣除了随机碰巧一致的部分，0=纯靠运气、1=完全一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cohen's kappa measures agreement between two annotators after correcting for chance, where 0 is pure luck and 1 is perfect agreement.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不同标注者对同一样本给出相同标签的程度，反映标签可信度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Inter-annotator agreement is how often different annotators assign the same label to the same item, reflecting label reliability.

scenario: 标注众包了上百个工人，你担心有人为了计件多、随手乱点，需要一个能持续发现「谁在乱标」的机制。
scenario_en: You crowdsource labeling to hundreds of workers and worry some click randomly to boost piece-rate; you need a way to continuously catch who is mislabeling.
q: 怎么在线监控每个标注者的准确率？
q_en: How do you monitor each annotator's accuracy online?
why: 把一批已知正确标签的 gold-standard 样例暗中混进任务流，标注者不知道哪些是考题，系统对比他在这些样例上的答案就能实时算出准确率，低于阈值就下线或复训。这是质控的核心闭环。
why_en: Seed known-answer gold-standard items covertly into the task stream and score each annotator against them in real time, dropping those below threshold.
options: 把已知标签的 gold-standard 样例暗中混进任务流，用标注者在这些样例上的答案实时算准确率
只在项目结束后抽查一次全部标签，中途不监控，发现问题再整批返工
让标注者自己上报置信度，置信度高的直接采信，不再另设考核样例
假设众包平台已筛过工人，默认所有标签可信，把质控交给下游模型训练时自然过滤
options_en: Covertly seed gold-standard items with known labels into the stream and score each annotator's answers on them in real time.
Spot-check all labels only once after the project ends, with no mid-stream monitoring, and rework the whole batch if problems appear.
Let annotators self-report confidence and accept high-confidence labels directly, with no separate audit items.
Assume the crowd platform pre-screened workers, trust all labels by default, and leave quality control to downstream model training.
optionExplanations: 对；暗桩考题让乱标者无处躲，实时算准确率就能在污染扩散前把人下线，是质控的主动闭环。
事后一次性抽查太晚，坏标签已灌满数据集，返工成本远高于过程中拦截。
自报置信度可以造假，乱标的人往往还很自信，没有客观考题就抓不出来。
指望下游模型过滤噪声很危险：DNN 会记住噪声标签、系统性偏移边界，过滤不掉。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — hidden audit items leave mislabelers nowhere to hide, and real-time accuracy lets you drop them before contamination spreads; it is the active QC loop.
A single post-hoc spot-check is too late — bad labels already fill the dataset and rework costs far more than intercepting mid-stream.
Self-reported confidence can be gamed, and careless labelers are often confident; without objective audit items you cannot catch them.
Counting on the downstream model to filter noise is dangerous: DNNs memorize noisy labels and systematically shift the boundary, so it is not filtered out.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把已知答案的暗桩样例混进任务，用来在线考核标注者准确率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Gold-standard injection mixes known-answer decoy items into tasks to audit annotator accuracy online.

termDefinitions.meaning: 深度神经网络；容量大到能记住甚至背下噪声标签。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A DNN (Deep Neural Network) has enough capacity to memorize and even fully fit noisy labels.

scenario: 多个标注者对同一条样本给了互相冲突的标签，需要一个机制决定最终标签，而不是随便取一个。
scenario_en: Multiple annotators gave conflicting labels for the same sample; you need a mechanism to decide the final label rather than picking one at random.
q: 标注分歧（disagreement）该怎么裁决（adjudication）？
q_en: How should annotation disagreements be adjudicated?
why: 把分歧样本路由给资深复核者定夺，或用多数投票聚合。关键是分歧不能沉默丢弃——它往往正是任务定义模糊或边界案例的信号，裁决同时能反哺去修标注指南。
why_en: Route disagreements to a senior reviewer or resolve by majority vote, since disagreement often flags ambiguous cases worth feeding back into the guidelines.
options: 把冲突样本随机保留其中一个标签，反正模型能容忍一点噪声，不值得额外处理
把冲突样本整条丢弃，只留全体标注者一致的样本进训练集
把分歧样本路由给资深复核者定夺，或用多数投票聚合出最终标签
以第一个提交的标注者为准，先到先得，避免多轮协调的开销
options_en: Keep one of the conflicting labels at random — the model tolerates some noise, so it is not worth extra handling.
Discard the whole conflicting sample and keep only items where all annotators agreed.
Route disagreements to a senior reviewer to decide, or aggregate via majority vote into a final label.
Go with whichever annotator submitted first, first-come-first-served, to avoid coordination overhead.
optionExplanations: 随机留一个把系统性分歧当成随机噪声处理，恰恰丢掉了边界案例携带的最有价值信息。
整条丢弃会系统性删掉困难样本，训练集只剩简单例，模型在真实边界上反而更弱。
对；资深仲裁或多数投票给出可信标签，分歧本身还是修订指南、发现边界案例的富信号。
先到先得毫无质量依据，速度快的标注者不等于对的，等于把决策权交给运气。
optionExplanations_en: Keeping one at random treats systematic disagreement as random noise, discarding exactly the high-value signal that edge cases carry.
Discarding the whole sample systematically deletes hard examples, leaving a training set of easy cases so the model is weaker at the real boundary.
Correct — senior adjudication or majority vote yields a trustworthy label, and the disagreement itself is rich signal for revising guidelines and finding edge cases.
First-come-first-served has no quality basis; a fast annotator is not a correct one, so it hands the decision to luck.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对标注者冲突的样本给出最终裁决，可用资深复核或多数投票。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Adjudication resolves conflicting annotations into a final label via senior review or majority vote.

scenario: 从零起一个内容审核系统：没有任何标签，预算有限，需要尽快把一批训练数据 bootstrap 出来。文本量大、类别可由规则大致刻画。
scenario_en: Bootstrapping a content-moderation system from zero: no labels, limited budget, need training data fast. Large text volume, categories roughly capturable by rules.
q: 初始标注策略最该选哪个？
q_en: Which initial labeling strategy fits best?
why: 选弱监督（Snorkel）先 bootstrap：工程师把审核规则写成 labeling functions，几行 Python 就能大规模产出概率标签，成本低、扩得快；再配一小撮专家标注的验证集守质量。纯人工又贵又慢，起步阶段扛不住。
why_en: Use weak supervision (Snorkel) to bootstrap: encode moderation rules as labeling functions that cheaply produce probabilistic labels at scale, plus a small expert validation set.
tradeoff: 弱监督(便宜、可扩、标签有噪) vs 纯专家(高质但贵且慢，起步扛不住)
options: 纯专家人工标注：从第一天就上放射科级别的高质量标注，把每条样本标到最准
自监督预训练：直接在无标签文本上做 MLM，跳过审核标签，靠 pretext 任务解决分类
弱监督（Snorkel）先 bootstrap：把审核规则写成 labeling functions 产出概率标签，配小验证集
半监督伪标签：先随便训一个弱模型，把它的高置信预测直接当最终标签铺满全量
options_en: Pure expert annotation: bring radiologist-grade labeling from day one and label every sample as accurately as possible.
Self-supervised pretraining: run MLM on the unlabeled text, skip moderation labels, and solve classification via the pretext task.
Weak supervision (Snorkel) to bootstrap: encode moderation rules as labeling functions that emit probabilistic labels, plus a small validation set.
Semi-supervised pseudo-labels: train a weak model on anything, then treat its high-confidence predictions as final labels across the whole corpus.
whenOtherWins: 如果是安全攸关且量小的任务（如医学诊断标注），质量压倒成本，就该直接上专家人工而非弱监督。
optionExplanations: 纯专家质量最高，但每小时上百美元、扩不上去，起步阶段预算和速度都不允许，是后期验证集才用的。
自监督只产出通用表征、不产出审核类别标签，解决不了「这条算不算违规」的分类目标。
对；规则可刻画 + 无标签 + 预算紧，正是弱监督主场：几行 Python 一个 labeling function，生成模型自动加权去噪。
半监督直接把弱模型高置信预测当真标签，会触发 confirmation bias，早期系统错误自我强化、噪声逐轮放大。
optionExplanations_en: Expert labeling is highest quality but hundreds of dollars an hour and unscalable; budget and speed forbid it at bootstrap, so it is reserved for a validation set.
Self-supervision produces general representations, not moderation-category labels, so it cannot answer the 'is this a violation' classification target.
Correct — rule-capturable, unlabeled, budget-tight is weak supervision's home turf: a labeling function is a few lines of Python and the generative model auto-weights and denoises.
Treating a weak model's high-confidence predictions as ground truth triggers confirmation bias, where early errors reinforce themselves and noise compounds each round.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一批有噪声的规则（labeling functions）代替人工，程序化地大规模产出标签。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Weak supervision replaces manual labeling with noisy rules (labeling functions) to produce labels programmatically at scale.

termDefinitions.meaning: 弱监督框架：把多个噪声 labeling function 的投票用生成模型聚合成概率标签。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Snorkel is a weak-supervision framework that aggregates votes from many noisy labeling functions into probabilistic labels via a generative model.

termDefinitions.meaning: 遮住部分 token 让模型预测，是 BERT 的自监督 pretext 任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MLM (Masked Language Modeling) masks tokens and predicts them, the self-supervised pretext task behind BERT.

scenario: 医学影像诊断标注：错一个标签可能致命，样本量不大，但每条都必须准。预算可以为质量让路。
scenario_en: Medical-imaging diagnosis labeling: a wrong label can be fatal, sample volume is modest, but each must be correct. Budget can yield to quality.
q: 该选哪种标注策略？
q_en: Which labeling strategy fits?
why: 安全攸关且量不大时，质量压倒成本与规模——直接上领域专家人工标注（放射科医生级）。众包/弱监督的中等质量在这里不可接受，一个 asymmetric 误标就会把决策边界推向危险方向。
why_en: When it is safety-critical and low-volume, quality beats cost and scale, so use domain-expert human labeling; crowd or weak-supervision quality is unacceptable here.
tradeoff: 专家人工(质量极高、贵、扩不上) vs 众包/弱监督(便宜可扩但质量中等，安全攸关不可接受)
options: 众包（MTurk）：把影像分发给大量普通工人，靠多数投票凑出标签，便宜又快
领域专家人工标注：放射科医生逐例复核，质量极高，接受高成本与低吞吐
弱监督：把诊断规则写成 labeling functions 批量产出概率标签，省掉医生
自监督：在无标签影像上做对比学习，直接拿表征当诊断结论
options_en: Crowdsourcing (MTurk): distribute images to many generic workers and majority-vote a label — cheap and fast.
Domain-expert labeling: radiologists review each case, very high quality, accepting high cost and low throughput.
Weak supervision: encode diagnostic rules as labeling functions to mass-produce probabilistic labels, skipping doctors.
Self-supervision: run contrastive learning on unlabeled images and use the representation as the diagnosis directly.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务不安全攸关且量极大（如商品图打标签），中等质量够用，就该转向众包或弱监督换规模和成本。
optionExplanations: 普通众包工人没有医学专长，多数投票只会把外行的错叠加，安全攸关任务承受不起这种噪声。
对；量小且错误致命，质量是硬约束，专家逐例是唯一能守住 ground truth 的选择，成本此时次要。
诊断规则难以用几条 labeling function 穷尽，弱监督的中等质量在致命误差场景不达标。
自监督只给通用表征、不给诊断标签，把表征当结论没有任何医学正确性保证。
optionExplanations_en: Generic crowd workers lack medical expertise; majority vote only stacks laypeople's errors, and a safety-critical task cannot absorb that noise.
Correct — low volume with fatal errors makes quality a hard constraint, and per-case experts are the only way to hold ground truth; cost is secondary here.
Diagnostic rules are hard to exhaust with a few labeling functions, so weak supervision's moderate quality falls short where errors are fatal.
Self-supervision yields only a general representation, not a diagnosis, and using it as the conclusion has no guarantee of medical correctness.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统性地把某一类错标成另一类，会把决策边界往偏的方向推，比对称噪声危险得多。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Asymmetric noise systematically mislabels one class as another, biasing the decision boundary far more than symmetric noise.

scenario: 目标不是分类，而是给下游任务预训练一批通用表征（embedding）。手头有海量无标签文本/图像，但几乎没有标签预算。
scenario_en: The goal is not classification but pretraining general-purpose representations (embeddings) for downstream tasks. Huge unlabeled corpus, almost no labeling budget.
q: 该用哪种「标注」策略？
q_en: Which labeling strategy fits?
why: 选自监督：从数据自身结构造监督信号（BERT 的 MLM 遮词预测、SimCLR 的对比学习、GPT 的下一 token），不需要人工标签，规模极大、成本极低，产出的通用表征还能大幅削减下游微调的标注需求。
why_en: Use self-supervision: derive the signal from the data's own structure (MLM, contrastive, next-token) with no human labels, cheaply producing general representations that cut downstream labeling.
tradeoff: 自监督(无需人工标签、极大规模、产通用表征) vs 人工标注(有针对性但贵，此处无预算)
options: 自监督 pretext 任务：用数据结构造监督（MLM 遮词预测 / 对比学习 / 下一 token），无需人工标签
专家人工标注：先花预算把语料逐条打上任务标签，再训练表征
半监督伪标签：先训个小模型给无标签数据打伪标签，再当作监督数据训表征
弱监督：写 labeling functions 给每条文本产出类别概率标签，再训表征
options_en: Self-supervised pretext tasks: derive supervision from data structure (MLM masked-token prediction / contrastive / next-token), no human labels.
Expert annotation: spend budget to label every item with task labels first, then train representations.
Semi-supervised pseudo-labels: train a small model to pseudo-label the unlabeled data, then use it as supervised data to train representations.
Weak supervision: write labeling functions to emit class-probability labels per text, then train representations.
whenOtherWins: 如果目标是一个具体的分类/审核任务而非通用表征，且已有明确类别定义，弱监督或人工标注更对口。
optionExplanations: 对；预训练通用表征本就不需要任务标签，自监督用数据自身结构造监督，规模最大、成本最低，正是它的主场。
花预算逐条打标签与「几乎没有标签预算」矛盾，而且预训练根本不需要任务标签，是资源错配。
半监督仍需一个初始有标签种子集来训小模型，这里连种子标签都没有，且目标是通用表征不是伪标签。
弱监督产出的是具体类别标签，不是通用表征；预训练不需要类别标签，用它是走偏了目标。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — pretraining general representations needs no task labels, and self-supervision derives signal from the data's own structure at maximum scale and minimum cost — its home turf.
Spending budget to label each item contradicts 'almost no labeling budget,' and pretraining does not need task labels at all — a resource mismatch.
Semi-supervision still needs an initial labeled seed set to train the small model; there is no seed here, and the goal is general representations, not pseudo-labels.
Weak supervision produces concrete class labels, not general representations; pretraining needs no class labels, so it misses the goal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从数据自身结构造监督信号（如遮词预测），无需人工标签就能学表征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Self-supervision creates a supervision signal from the data's own structure (e.g. masked-token prediction) with no human labels.

termDefinitions.fullName: Simple framework for Contrastive Learning of visual Representations
termDefinitions.meaning: 对比学习框架：把同一图像的两个增强视图拉近、与其他图像推远。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SimCLR is a contrastive-learning framework that pulls two augmented views of the same image together and pushes other images apart.

termDefinitions.meaning: 自监督里人为设计的、答案可从数据自动得到的训练任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A pretext task is a self-supervised training task whose answer is automatically derived from the data itself.

scenario: 文本分类任务，类别可由规则大致刻画，量很大、预算低，但众包在这个领域质量只是中等。
scenario_en: Text-classification task with rule-capturable categories, large volume, low budget, and only moderate crowd quality in this domain.
q: 在「可扩展性 × 成本」这条轴上，弱监督相对众包的关键优势是什么？
q_en: On the scalability-vs-cost axis, what is weak supervision's key edge over crowdsourcing?
why: 众包靠人力线性堆，规模和成本都被人数卡住；弱监督把领域知识写成 labeling functions，一条函数就能程序化标遍全量、边际成本近零，所以在「高扩展 + 低成本」这一格明显胜出，代价是标签只有中等质量、需要生成模型去噪。
why_en: Crowd scales linearly with headcount, but weak supervision's labeling functions label the whole corpus programmatically at near-zero marginal cost, winning on scale and cost at the price of moderate label quality.
tradeoff: 弱监督(高扩展、低成本、中等质量) vs 众包(中等扩展、中等成本、中等质量、靠人力线性堆)
options: 弱监督的单条标签质量比众包高得多，所以能直接省掉验证集
弱监督用 labeling functions 程序化标遍全量、边际成本近零，扩展性和成本都胜过靠人力线性堆的众包
弱监督不需要任何领域知识，随便写几条函数就能自动达到专家级质量
弱监督能实时反映最新数据分布，永远不需要监控 drift 或调整函数
options_en: Weak supervision's per-label quality is far higher than crowd's, so it lets you skip the validation set.
Weak supervision labels the whole corpus programmatically via labeling functions at near-zero marginal cost, beating headcount-linear crowdsourcing on scale and cost.
Weak supervision needs no domain knowledge — a few arbitrary functions auto-reach expert-level quality.
Weak supervision always reflects the latest data distribution, so it never needs drift monitoring or function tuning.
optionExplanations: 错在质量：弱监督单条标签只是中等（有噪），恰恰更需要验证集守质量，不是省掉它。
对；关键差异在边际成本——labeling function 写一次跑全量，众包每条都要付人力，规模一大差距指数级拉开。
写函数正是在编码领域知识；没有领域知识函数就是瞎猜，生成模型也救不回来。
labeling functions 会随分布漂移失效，必须版本化并监控 drift，这句把它的最大运维负担说反了。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong on quality: weak-supervision labels are only moderate (noisy), so you need the validation set more, not less.
Correct — the key difference is marginal cost: a labeling function is written once and runs over everything, while crowd pays per item, so the gap widens exponentially at scale.
Writing functions is exactly encoding domain knowledge; without it the functions guess and the generative model cannot recover.
Labeling functions decay under distribution shift and must be versioned and drift-monitored — this reverses their biggest operational burden.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一段编码领域知识的噪声规则（如关键词、发件人信誉），程序化地给样本投票打标签。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A labeling function is a noisy rule encoding domain knowledge (keyword, sender reputation) that programmatically votes a label on samples.

termDefinitions.meaning: 命名实体识别：从文本中标出人名、地名、机构等实体。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NER (Named Entity Recognition) tags entities like people, places, and organizations in text.

scenario: 垃圾邮件分类，工程师写了几条噪声 labeling function：关键词命中、发件人信誉低、URL 在黑名单——它们会冲突也会相关。Snorkel 要把这些噪声投票融合成能训练的标签。
scenario_en: Spam classification with several noisy labeling functions: keyword hit, low sender reputation, URL on a blocklist — they conflict and correlate. Snorkel must fuse these noisy votes into trainable labels.
q: Snorkel 的生成模型（generative model）在其中扮演什么角色？
q_en: What role does Snorkel's generative model play?
why: 生成模型不看真标签，而是从多条 labeling function 的投票模式里估计每条函数的准确率和它们之间的相关性（依赖结构），据此把冲突的噪声投票融合成去噪后的概率标签，交给下游判别模型训练。
why_en: The generative model estimates each labeling function's accuracy and their correlation structure from their voting patterns, fusing noisy votes into denoised probabilistic labels.
options: 它直接生成新的训练文本样本，把数据集扩充到更大规模
它是最终的分类器，直接对邮件输出 spam / not-spam 的判别结果
它从各 labeling function 的投票模式估计它们的准确率与相关性，融合噪声投票产出去噪概率标签
它给每条 labeling function 人工分配一个固定权重，权重由工程师凭经验手填
options_en: It directly generates new training text samples to expand the dataset to a larger scale.
It is the final classifier, directly outputting spam / not-spam decisions on emails.
It estimates each labeling function's accuracy and their correlation from their voting patterns, fusing noisy votes into denoised probabilistic labels.
It assigns each labeling function a fixed weight that engineers hand-tune from experience.
optionExplanations: 生成模型不造样本，它建模的是 labeling function 的可靠性结构，不改变数据量。
判别是下游模型的活；生成模型只负责把噪声投票去噪成概率标签，两者分工不同。
对；它无监督地从投票一致/冲突模式反推每条函数多准、彼此多相关，据此加权融合，加一条函数就自动重标定。
手填权重正是它要取代的——生成模型自动估计权重，加函数无需人工重调，这是 Snorkel 的核心便利。
optionExplanations_en: The generative model does not synthesize samples; it models the labeling functions' reliability structure and does not change data volume.
Classification is the downstream model's job; the generative model only denoises noisy votes into probabilistic labels — a different role.
Correct — it infers unsupervised from agreement/conflict patterns how accurate and correlated each function is, then weight-fuses accordingly and auto-recalibrates when a function is added.
Hand-tuned weights are exactly what it replaces — the generative model estimates weights automatically, so adding a function needs no manual retuning, Snorkel's core convenience.

termDefinitions.meaning: Snorkel 第一阶段：从 labeling function 的投票模式估计各函数准确率与相关性，产出概率标签。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Snorkel's generative model estimates each labeling function's accuracy and correlations from voting patterns to produce probabilistic labels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 下游用概率标签训练的分类器，是真正上线做预测的模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The discriminative model is the downstream classifier trained on the probabilistic labels and deployed to predict.

termDefinitions.meaning: 带置信度的软标签（如 0.8 spam），比硬 0/1 标签保留了不确定性信息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A probabilistic label is a soft label with confidence (e.g. 0.8 spam), retaining uncertainty a hard 0/1 label discards.

q: 把 Snorkel 弱监督的两阶段流程排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order Snorkel's two-stage weak-supervision flow correctly:
steps: 工程师把领域知识写成多条噪声 labeling function（关键词、发件人信誉、URL 黑名单）
生成模型估计每条函数的准确率与相关性，融合投票产出概率标签
下游判别模型用这些概率标签训练，成为上线预测的分类器
labeling functions 对同一样本投票，可能一致、冲突或弃权
why: 先写 labeling functions → 它们对样本投票（有冲突有弃权）→ 生成模型据投票模式估计各函数可靠性并去噪出概率标签 → 判别模型用概率标签训练上线。加一条函数只是重跑生成模型自动重标定，几行 Python 的成本。
why_en: Write labeling functions, let them vote, have the generative model denoise votes into probabilistic labels by estimating reliability, then train the discriminative model on those labels.
diagram:
flowchart LR L["写 labeling functions"] --> V["函数对样本投票"] V --> G["生成模型估可靠性
去噪出概率标签"] G --> D["判别模型训练上线"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 编码领域知识的噪声规则，对样本投票打标签，可冲突可弃权。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A labeling function is a noisy domain-knowledge rule that votes a label on samples and may conflict or abstain.

termDefinitions.meaning: Snorkel 用来估计各函数可靠性、把噪声投票融合成概率标签的模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Snorkel's generative model estimates function reliability and fuses noisy votes into probabilistic labels.

scenario: 弱监督上线三个月后，垃圾邮件的花样变了（新话术、新域名），原来靠关键词和 URL 黑名单的 labeling functions 悄悄失准，但没有报错。
scenario_en: Three months after deploying weak supervision, spam tactics shift (new phrasing, new domains); the keyword and blocklist labeling functions silently lose accuracy with no error.
q: labeling functions 在运维上必须做什么？
q_en: What must labeling functions have operationally?
why: labeling functions 是会随分布漂移失效的代码，必须版本化、监控 drift、随分布变化调整——就像特征一样。不监控就会像这里：规则悄悄失准、概率标签变脏、下游模型退化却查不出改动。
why_en: Labeling functions are code that decays under distribution shift, so version them, monitor drift, and adjust them as distributions move.
options: 写好后就固定不动，函数是纯逻辑规则，分布怎么变都不影响它的正确性
必须版本化、监控 drift、随分布变化调整——它们是会随分布漂移失效的代码
每次数据分布一变就整套推倒重写，历史版本没有保留价值
只要生成模型在，函数准不准都无所谓，去噪会自动补偿任何失准
options_en: Fix them once and never touch them — functions are pure logic rules, so distribution shift cannot affect their correctness.
Version them, monitor drift, and adjust as distributions change — they are code that decays under distribution shift.
Rewrite the whole set from scratch every time the distribution moves; old versions have no value worth keeping.
As long as the generative model exists, function accuracy does not matter — denoising auto-compensates any drift.
optionExplanations: 规则依赖具体特征（关键词、域名），分布一变规则命中的还是不是 spam 就变了，固定不动等于放任失准。
对；把 labeling function 当特征一样管理——版本化能回溯、drift 监控能预警、随分布调整能保鲜，正是这里失准前缺的机制。
推倒重写丢掉历史版本，无法对比是哪次改动导致标签变脏，也无法回滚，运维上很危险。
生成模型只在函数整体有可用信号时才能去噪；若多数函数一起失准，它无从判断谁对，去噪也失效。
optionExplanations_en: Rules depend on concrete features (keywords, domains); when the distribution shifts, what a rule catches may no longer be spam, so freezing them means letting accuracy rot.
Correct — manage labeling functions like features: versioning enables rollback, drift monitoring warns early, and adjustment keeps them fresh — exactly what was missing before the silent decay.
Rewriting from scratch discards history, so you cannot tell which change dirtied the labels or roll back — operationally dangerous.
The generative model can only denoise when the functions collectively carry usable signal; if most drift together, it cannot tell who is right and denoising fails too.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上数据分布随时间偏离训练时的分布，使原有规则或模型悄悄失准。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Drift is the production data distribution moving away from training over time, silently degrading rules or models.

scenario: 面试官问：BERT、SimCLR、GPT 这些模型没有人工标签，是怎么学到有用表征的？
scenario_en: Interviewer: with no human labels, how do models like BERT, SimCLR, and GPT learn useful representations?
q: 自监督的三类 pretext 任务分别怎么造监督信号？
q_en: How do the three self-supervised pretext tasks each create a supervision signal?
why: 都从数据自身结构造答案：MLM（BERT）遮住部分 token 让模型预测被遮的；对比学习（SimCLR）把同一样本的两个增强视图拉近、与其他样本推远；下一 token（GPT）预测序列里的下一个词。答案天然在数据里，不需人工标注。
why_en: All derive answers from the data itself: MLM masks and predicts tokens, contrastive learning pulls augmented views of one item together and pushes others apart, and next-token predicts the following word.
options: MLM 让人工遮词并写出正确答案；对比学习让人标注哪两张图相似；GPT 让人写下一句
MLM 遮 token 预测被遮的；对比学习拉近同一样本的增强视图、推远其他；GPT 预测下一 token
三者都需要一个小型人工标注种子集来启动，本质仍是监督学习的变体
三者都直接输出分类标签，pretext 任务就是最终的下游分类任务本身
options_en: MLM has people mask words and write the answers; contrastive learning has people label which two images are similar; GPT has people write the next sentence.
MLM masks tokens and predicts them; contrastive learning pulls augmented views of one item together and pushes others apart; GPT predicts the next token.
All three need a small human-labeled seed set to start and are essentially variants of supervised learning.
All three directly output classification labels; the pretext task is the final downstream classification task itself.
optionExplanations: 全错在「让人工」：自监督的卖点正是答案从数据自动生成、无需人工，这里把它讲成了人工标注。
对；三种方式的共性是监督信号来自数据结构本身——遮词、增强视图、序列顺序，天然自带答案。
自监督不需要人工种子集，这正是它区别于半监督（需小种子集）的地方，别混淆。
pretext 任务是代理任务、不是下游任务；它产出的是通用表征，下游还要另接分类头微调。
optionExplanations_en: All wrong on 'have people': self-supervision's whole point is that answers come from the data automatically, with no humans — this recasts it as manual labeling.
Correct — the common thread is that the signal comes from the data's own structure: masking, augmented views, sequence order all carry the answer natively.
Self-supervision needs no human seed set — that is exactly what distinguishes it from semi-supervision (which needs a small seed); do not conflate them.
A pretext task is a proxy, not the downstream task; it yields general representations, and downstream still attaches a classification head to fine-tune.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把同一样本的不同视图在向量空间拉近、与不同样本推远，学出判别性表征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Contrastive learning pulls different views of the same item together in vector space and pushes different items apart to learn discriminative representations.

termDefinitions.term: next-token prediction / 下一 token 预测
termDefinitions.meaning: 预测序列中的下一个 token，是 GPT 类模型的自监督目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Next-token prediction predicts the following token in a sequence, the self-supervised objective of GPT-style models.

scenario: 都想少用人工标签，但一个从零无标签起步、一个手头有一小撮已标注种子加海量无标签数据。
scenario_en: Both want to minimize human labels, but one starts from zero labels and the other has a small labeled seed plus a huge unlabeled pool.
q: 自监督 vs 半监督，关键区别在哪一维？
q_en: Self-supervised vs semi-supervised — on which dimension do they differ?
why: 区别在是否需要初始标签：自监督完全不用人工标签，从数据结构造 pretext 任务学通用表征；半监督需要一个小的已标注种子集，先训模型再给高置信无标签样本打伪标签、折回训练。半监督的风险是 confirmation bias。
why_en: The dimension is initial labels: self-supervision needs none and learns from data structure, while semi-supervision needs a small labeled seed to pseudo-label the unlabeled pool.
tradeoff: 自监督(零标签、学通用表征) vs 半监督(需小种子集、伪标签扩充、有 confirmation bias 风险)
options: 区别只在模型大小：自监督用大模型、半监督用小模型，标签需求上其实一样
关键区别是是否需要初始标签：自监督零标签，半监督需小种子集再伪标签扩充
自监督需要种子标签、半监督不需要，半监督才是完全无监督的那个
两者完全等价，只是不同论文对同一方法的两种叫法
options_en: They differ only in model size: self-supervision uses a big model, semi-supervision a small one; label needs are actually the same.
The key difference is initial labels: self-supervision needs none, semi-supervision needs a small seed set then pseudo-labels to expand.
Self-supervision needs seed labels and semi-supervision does not; semi-supervision is the fully unsupervised one.
They are fully equivalent, just two names different papers use for the same method.
optionExplanations: 模型大小不是区分维度，标签需求也不一样——自监督零标签、半监督要种子集，这句把两者的本质差异抹掉了。
对；分水岭就是初始标签：自监督从数据结构自造答案，半监督靠一小撮真标签起手再自我扩充。
说反了：自监督才是零标签、半监督需要种子集，这个选项把两者的标签需求对调了。
两者机制不同、风险不同（半监督有 confirmation bias），绝非同一方法的别名。
optionExplanations_en: Model size is not the distinguishing axis, and label needs differ — self needs zero, semi needs a seed — so this erases the essential difference.
Correct — the watershed is initial labels: self-supervision manufactures answers from structure, semi-supervision starts from a small set of real labels then self-expands.
Backwards: self-supervision is the zero-label one and semi-supervision needs a seed set; this swaps their label requirements.
Their mechanisms and risks differ (semi-supervision has confirmation bias), so they are not aliases for one method.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用小的已标注种子集加大量无标签数据，给高置信无标签样本打伪标签折回训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Semi-supervision uses a small labeled seed plus large unlabeled data, pseudo-labeling high-confidence unlabeled samples back into training.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型给无标签样本自己打的标签，高置信的被折回当训练数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A pseudo-label is a label the model assigns to unlabeled data, with high-confidence ones folded back as training data.

scenario: 半监督伪标签：模型给高置信无标签样本打上标签折回训练，但初始模型对某一类有系统性偏差，会把一批本不属于该类的样本高置信地误标。
scenario_en: Semi-supervised pseudo-labeling folds high-confidence labels back into training, but the initial model has a systematic bias for one class and confidently mislabels many samples.
q: 这里潜伏的核心风险是什么，怎么缓解？
q_en: What is the core lurking risk here, and how do you mitigate it?
why: 是 confirmation bias（确认偏差）：早期的系统性错误被当成伪标签折回训练，模型学得更偏、下一轮更自信地重复同样的错，噪声逐轮复利放大。缓解靠一致性正则、只信真正高置信的样本、并用干净验证集把关每轮。
why_en: It is confirmation bias: early systematic errors become pseudo-labels that reinforce themselves and compound each round, mitigated by consistency regularization and a clean validation gate.
options: 风险是训练变慢；缓解方法是加大 batch size 让每轮吃更多伪标签
风险是 confirmation bias——早期系统性错误被折回自我强化、逐轮复利；靠一致性正则+干净验证集把关缓解
风险是标签太少；缓解方法是把所有无标签样本无论置信度全部打伪标签折回
没有真正风险，伪标签越多越好，模型会自动纠正早期的错误
options_en: The risk is slower training; mitigate by increasing batch size so each round consumes more pseudo-labels.
The risk is confirmation bias — early systematic errors fold back and self-reinforce, compounding each round; mitigate with consistency regularization plus a clean validation gate.
The risk is too few labels; mitigate by pseudo-labeling all unlabeled samples regardless of confidence and folding them back.
There is no real risk — more pseudo-labels is always better and the model auto-corrects early mistakes.
optionExplanations: 问题不是速度而是标签正确性；加大 batch 只会更快地把错误伪标签灌进去，火上浇油。
对；正常路径是折回高置信样本，但初始偏差让错标高置信地进来，逐轮自我强化——必须靠一致性正则和干净验证集在每轮拦住漂移。
不看置信度全量伪标签会把大量错标一次性灌入，正是把 confirmation bias 从慢性变急性。
模型不会自动纠正自己造的错——它把错标当真理学，只会越陷越深，这是该方法最经典的陷阱。
optionExplanations_en: The problem is not speed but label correctness; a bigger batch just injects wrong pseudo-labels faster, pouring fuel on the fire.

Correct — the normal path folds back high-confidence samples, but the initial bias lets mislabels enter confidently and self-reinforce each round, so you gate drift every round with consistency regularization and a clean validation set.
Pseudo-labeling everything regardless of confidence dumps many mislabels at once, turning confirmation bias from chronic into acute.
The model does not auto-correct its own errors — it learns mislabels as truth and sinks deeper, the method's classic trap.

termDefinitions.meaning: 半监督里早期系统性错误被当伪标签折回，模型自我强化同一错误，噪声逐轮放大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Confirmation bias is when early systematic errors become pseudo-labels the model reinforces, compounding noise each round.

termDefinitions.meaning: 要求模型对同一样本的扰动版本给出一致预测，抑制伪标签噪声。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistency regularization requires stable predictions under input perturbations, damping pseudo-label noise.

scenario: 两个数据集都有 10% 标签错误：A 的错误是均匀随机翻转（任何类等概率标错），B 是系统性把「良性」错标成「欺诈」。同样错误率，危害却不同。
scenario_en: Two datasets each have 10% label errors: A flips uniformly at random across classes, B systematically mislabels 'benign' as 'fraud'. Same error rate, different harm.
q: 对称噪声 vs 非对称噪声，哪个更伤模型，为什么？
q_en: Symmetric vs asymmetric label noise — which hurts more, and why?
why: 非对称噪声更伤：它系统性地把某一类错标成另一类，把决策边界往一个有偏方向整体推移；对称噪声（均匀翻转）在低比率下相对良性，因为错误各向抵消、不带方向。所以要问的不只是噪声率，还有噪声的方向性。
why_en: Asymmetric noise hurts more because it systematically shifts the decision boundary in a biased direction, while symmetric uniform flips are relatively benign at low rates.
tradeoff: 对称噪声(均匀翻转、低率良性、无方向) vs 非对称噪声(系统性偏移边界、危害大)
options: 对称噪声更伤：均匀翻转会把所有类别一起搅乱，比只错一类严重得多
两者危害完全一样，只要噪声率相同，模型受影响就相同，方向无所谓
非对称噪声更伤：它系统性错标某类、把决策边界往有偏方向整体推移；对称噪声低率下相对良性
非对称噪声其实更好，因为错误集中在一类，训练时更容易被发现和剔除
options_en: Symmetric noise hurts more: uniform flips scramble all classes together, far worse than mislabeling just one class.
The harm is identical: as long as the noise rate matches, the model is affected equally and direction does not matter.
Asymmetric noise hurts more: it systematically mislabels one class and shifts the decision boundary in a biased direction, while symmetric noise is relatively benign at low rates.
Asymmetric noise is actually better because the errors concentrate in one class and are easier to spot and remove during training.
optionExplanations: 反了：对称噪声无方向、各向抵消，低率下最良性，不是最伤的那个。
方向恰恰是关键变量：同样 10% 错误率，有方向的非对称噪声把边界推偏，无方向的对称噪声大体抵消。
对；危害来自方向性——非对称把边界系统性推向一侧，模型在真实分布上整体偏。噪声率之外必须问方向。
集中在一类不等于容易剔除；它恰恰更像真实信号、更难与真样本区分，危害更隐蔽。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: symmetric noise is directionless and cancels out, most benign at low rates, not the most harmful.
Direction is exactly the key variable: at the same 10% rate, directional asymmetric noise biases the boundary while directionless symmetric noise largely cancels.
Correct — the harm comes from directionality: asymmetric noise pushes the boundary systematically to one side, biasing the model on the real distribution, so ask about direction beyond the rate.
Concentrating in one class does not make it easy to remove; it looks more like real signal and is harder to separate from true samples, making the harm stealthier.

termDefinitions.meaning: 标签在各类间均匀随机翻转，无方向，低比率下相对无害。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Symmetric noise flips labels uniformly at random across classes, directionless and relatively harmless at low rates.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统性地把某一类错标成另一类，会把决策边界往有偏方向推移。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Asymmetric noise systematically mislabels one class as another, shifting the decision boundary in a biased direction.

scenario: 训练集里混了一批错标样本，你以为大容量深度网络会「自动忽略」少量噪声，实际发现它在训练集上损失降到很低但泛化变差。
scenario_en: The training set contains some mislabeled samples; you assumed a high-capacity deep net would ignore a little noise, but training loss drops very low while generalization worsens.
q: 深度网络遇到噪声标签会发生什么后果？
q_en: What happens when a deep network meets noisy labels?
why: DNN 容量大到能把噪声标签整个背下来——它会把错标样本也拟合进去，训练损失很低但学的是错误映射，泛化下降。所以不能指望模型自动忽略噪声，必须在数据侧先清理（confident learning）或在损失侧降权。
why_en: A DNN has enough capacity to memorize noisy labels entirely, fitting the wrong examples so training loss drops but generalization degrades.
options: 网络会自动识别并忽略噪声标签，噪声越多它越鲁棒，不需要任何处理
网络容量大到能把噪声标签整个背下来、拟合错标样本，训练损失低但泛化变差
网络会直接拒绝训练、报错退出，直到你把所有错标清干净为止
噪声只影响训练速度，不影响最终精度，多训几轮就能自然抹平
options_en: The network auto-detects and ignores noisy labels — the more noise, the more robust it gets, needing no handling.
The network has enough capacity to memorize noisy labels entirely, fitting the mislabeled examples so training loss drops but generalization worsens.
The network refuses to train and errors out until you have cleaned every mislabeled example.
Noise only affects training speed, not final accuracy; a few more epochs smooth it over naturally.
optionExplanations: 恰恰相反：DNN 不会忽略噪声，它有足够容量去记住噪声，越训越把错映射刻进去。
对；记忆容量是双刃剑——能拟合复杂真信号，也能背下错标，表现为训练损失低而泛化崩，必须主动清噪或降权。
网络不会因噪声报错，它照训不误还训得「很好」，这种沉默正是噪声最危险的地方。
噪声改变的是学到的映射本身、不是速度；多训只会把错标记得更牢，精度只降不升。
optionExplanations_en: Quite the opposite: a DNN does not ignore noise — it has the capacity to memorize it, engraving the wrong mapping the more it trains.

Correct — memorization capacity is double-edged: it fits complex real signal and also memorizes mislabels, showing as low training loss but collapsed generalization, so denoise or down-weight actively.
The network does not error out on noise; it trains happily and 'well,' and that silence is exactly what makes noise so dangerous.
Noise changes the learned mapping itself, not the speed; more epochs only memorize mislabels harder, so accuracy only falls.

termDefinitions.meaning: 深度网络用大容量逐样本背下训练标签（含错标），训练损失低但泛化差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Memorization is a deep net using its capacity to fit training labels sample-by-sample (including wrong ones), lowering training loss but hurting generalization.

scenario: 训练集有一定比例错标，你想在训练前或训练中减轻它对模型的伤害。
scenario_en: The training set has some mislabeled fraction; you want to reduce its harm to the model before or during training.
q: 对付标签噪声有哪些常用缓解手段？(多选)
q_en: Which are common mitigations for label noise? (multiple)
why: 三条主线：confident learning 估计噪声/真标签的联合分布、训练前剔除疑似错标；loss reweighting 给高损失（疑似错标）样本降权；noise-robust losses（如对称交叉熵）从损失函数层面降低对错标的敏感度。加大模型容量只会更彻底地背下噪声，是反向操作。
why_en: Confident learning removes likely mislabels pre-training, loss reweighting down-weights high-loss suspects, and noise-robust losses reduce sensitivity to wrong labels.
options: Confident learning：估计噪声与真标签的联合分布，训练前剔除疑似错标样本
Loss reweighting：给高损失（疑似错标）的样本降权，削弱它们对梯度的影响
Noise-robust losses：用对称交叉熵等对错标不敏感的损失函数
加大模型容量：让更大的网络把噪声一并拟合进去，噪声就不再是问题
options_en: Confident learning: estimate the joint distribution of noisy and true labels and remove likely mislabels before training.
Loss reweighting: down-weight high-loss (likely mislabeled) samples to weaken their gradient influence.
Noise-robust losses: use loss functions insensitive to mislabels, such as symmetric cross-entropy.
Increase model capacity: let a bigger network fit the noise too, so noise stops being a problem.
optionExplanations: 对；先估计错标概率、在数据侧动手清掉最可疑的样本，是把噪声挡在训练之前的主动手段。
对；错标样本通常损失偏高，据此降权让它们少影响梯度，是训练中在线抑噪。
对；换一个对翻转标签不敏感的损失函数，从优化目标层面自带鲁棒性。
错；容量越大越能整个背下噪声、拟合错标，这是加重问题而非缓解，方向相反。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — estimate mislabel probability and clean the most suspect samples on the data side, blocking noise before training.
Correct — mislabeled samples usually have high loss, so down-weighting them cuts their gradient influence, an in-training online damper.
Correct — swapping in a loss insensitive to flipped labels builds robustness into the optimization objective itself.
Wrong — more capacity memorizes noise more completely and fits mislabels, worsening the problem, not mitigating it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 估计噪声标签与真标签的联合分布，据此在训练前定位并剔除疑似错标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Confident learning estimates the joint distribution of noisy and true labels to locate and remove likely mislabels before training.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对翻转标签不敏感的损失函数（如对称交叉熵），削弱错标对训练的影响。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A noise-robust loss (e.g. symmetric cross-entropy) is insensitive to flipped labels, weakening mislabels' effect on training.

scenario: 标注预算有限，模型手上有海量无标签数据，想让每一条送去人工标注的样本都尽量涨最多的性能。
scenario_en: Labeling budget is limited and the model has a huge unlabeled pool; you want each sample sent for annotation to buy the most performance.
q: 主动学习（active learning）的核心思路是什么？
q_en: What is the core idea of active learning?
why: 主动学习让模型自己挑「最该标」的无标签样本去请人标注，最大化每条标签的信息增益，而不是随机抽。典型判据是不确定性（模型最没把握的样本，softmax 接近 0.5）——标这些点最能纠正模型的模糊边界。
why_en: Active learning lets the model pick the most informative unlabeled samples to annotate, maximizing information per label rather than sampling at random.
options: 从无标签池里随机均匀抽样送标注，保证覆盖分布、不引入选择偏差
让模型自己挑最该标的样本（如最不确定的）送人工标注，最大化每条标签的信息增益
把全部无标签数据一次性送去标注，多多益善，不做任何选择
只标注模型已经最有把握的样本，先把简单的标完积累量
options_en: Uniformly random-sample the unlabeled pool for annotation to guarantee distribution coverage and avoid selection bias.
Let the model pick the most worth-labeling samples (e.g. the most uncertain) for annotation, maximizing information gain per label.
Send the entire unlabeled pool for annotation all at once — the more the better, with no selection.
Label only the samples the model is already most confident about, clearing the easy ones first to build volume.
optionExplanations: 随机抽样是主动学习要超越的基线——它不看模型状态，多数标签花在模型早就学会的区域，浪费预算。
对；核心是让模型驱动选择、把有限预算投到信息增益最高的样本上，不确定性采样是最常见的判据。
全量标注就是没有预算约束的假设，与「预算有限」矛盾，也失去了主动学习的意义。
只标最有把握的样本信息增益几乎为零——模型早会了，标了也学不到新东西，恰好选反了。
optionExplanations_en: Random sampling is the baseline active learning beats — it ignores model state and spends most labels on regions already learned, wasting budget.
Correct — the core is model-driven selection, putting the limited budget on the highest information-gain samples, with uncertainty sampling the most common criterion.
Labeling everything assumes no budget constraint, contradicting 'limited budget' and defeating the point of active learning.
Labeling only the most confident samples has near-zero information gain — the model already knows them, so it picks exactly the wrong ones.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型主动挑选最有信息量的无标签样本去请人标注，最大化每条标签的收益。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Active learning has the model proactively pick the most informative unlabeled samples to annotate, maximizing gain per label.

termDefinitions.meaning: 标注一个样本后模型不确定性下降的幅度，衡量这条标签值不值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Information gain is how much a sample's annotation reduces model uncertainty, measuring whether that label is worth it.

scenario: 不确定性采样有三种常见度量方式，都在挑「模型最没把握」的样本，但用不同的量刻画「没把握」。
scenario_en: Uncertainty sampling has three common measures, all picking the samples the model is least sure about, but quantifying 'unsure' differently.
q: 补全三种不确定性度量的判据：
q_en: Fill in the criteria of the three uncertainty measures:
text: least confidence：选最大类概率 {{最小}} 的样本；margin：选前两类概率 {{差距最小}} 的样本；entropy：选 H = −Σ_c p(c)·log p(c) {{最大}} 的样本。三者都在找 softmax 最接近 {{0.5}}（最模糊）的点。
text_en: least confidence: pick samples whose top class probability is {{lowest}}; margin: pick samples with the {{smallest gap}} between the top two class probabilities; entropy: pick samples with the {{highest}} H = −Σ_c p(c)·log p(c). All seek the softmax closest to {{0.5}} (most ambiguous).
why: H = −Σ_c p(c)·log p(c) 是香农熵，单位是 bits（以 2 为底）或 nats（以 e 为底），衡量预测分布的不确定度；分布越平（各类概率越接近），熵越大、模型越没把握。它的下游用途是给无标签样本排序，熵最高的先送人工标注。
why_en: Entropy H = minus sum p log p (Shannon entropy, in bits or nats) measures how flat the prediction is, and the highest-entropy samples are queued first for annotation.

termDefinitions.meaning: H=−Σ p(c)·log p(c)，衡量预测分布不确定度，分布越平熵越大；单位 bits（底2）或 nats（底e）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Entropy H = minus sum p(c) log p(c) measures how uncertain a prediction distribution is; flatter means higher, in bits (base 2) or nats (base e).

termDefinitions.meaning: 以最大类概率作为置信度，选该值最小的样本，即模型最没把握的。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Least confidence uses the top class probability as confidence and picks samples where it is smallest — the model's least-sure points.

termDefinitions.meaning: 看前两类概率的差距，差距最小说明模型在两类间摇摆，最该标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Margin sampling looks at the gap between the top two class probabilities; the smallest gap means the model waffles between two classes and most needs a label.

scenario: 你用纯不确定性采样跑主动学习，发现选出来的样本很多是标注者都难判、甚至本身就是脏数据的边界怪点，标了对模型帮助有限。
scenario_en: Running active learning with pure uncertainty sampling, many selected samples are hard even for annotators or are just dirty boundary outliers, and labeling them barely helps.
q: 不确定性采样的这个失效模式是什么，怎么补？
q_en: What is this failure mode of uncertainty sampling, and how do you patch it?
why: 纯不确定性采样会过采离群点和噪声边界点——这些点模型确实没把握，但没把握是因为它们是异常/脏数据，标了不代表分布，涨点有限。补法是掺入多样性/coreset 采样，保证选出的批次在特征空间铺得开、有代表性；生产里常用 BADGE 之类混合法同时兼顾不确定性和多样性。
why_en: Pure uncertainty sampling oversamples outliers and noisy boundary points that are unrepresentative, so mix in diversity/coreset selection or a hybrid like BADGE.
diagram:
flowchart LR P["无标签池"] --> U["不确定性打分"] U --> D["多样性/coreset
去冗余、铺开覆盖"] D --> B["选一批送标注"]
options: 失效模式是选出的样本太简单；补法是只保留模型最有把握的点
失效模式是过采离群点/噪声边界点、不代表分布；补法是掺多样性/coreset 采样或用 BADGE 混合
失效模式是标注太慢；补法是把不确定性阈值调高、少选一点
没有失效模式，不确定性采样总是最优，选到怪点说明数据本身有问题，与方法无关
options_en: The failure mode is that selected samples are too easy; patch it by keeping only the model's most confident points.
The failure mode is oversampling outliers/noisy boundary points that are unrepresentative; patch with diversity/coreset selection or a BADGE hybrid.
The failure mode is slow annotation; patch by raising the uncertainty threshold to select fewer points.
There is no failure mode — uncertainty sampling is always optimal, and hitting weird points just means the data is bad, unrelated to the method.
optionExplanations: 反了：不确定性采样选的是最难的点、不是最简单的，且只留高置信点信息增益近零。
对；不确定的点里混着离群/脏数据，标了不代表主分布；掺多样性让选批在特征空间铺开，BADGE 用梯度嵌入同时抓不确定性和多样性。
调阈值只改数量、不改「怪点占比高」这个结构问题，慢不是这里的失效模式。
选到怪点正是方法本身的偏好导致的，说它与方法无关等于否认这个公认的失效模式。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: uncertainty sampling picks the hardest points, not the easiest, and keeping only high-confidence points has near-zero information gain.

Correct — uncertain points mix in outliers/dirty data that misrepresent the main distribution; adding diversity spreads the batch across feature space, and BADGE uses gradient embeddings to capture both uncertainty and diversity.
Tuning the threshold changes only quantity, not the structural problem of a high outlier fraction, and slowness is not the failure mode here.
Hitting weird points is caused by the method's own preference, so calling it unrelated to the method denies this well-known failure mode.

termDefinitions.meaning: 选一批在特征空间铺得最开、最有代表性的样本；贪心 coreset 每次选到已选集合最远的点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Diversity/coreset sampling picks a batch with maximal feature-space coverage; greedy coreset picks the point farthest from the already-selected set.

termDefinitions.meaning: 远离主分布的异常样本，模型对它没把握但它不代表整体。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An outlier is an anomalous sample far from the main distribution that the model is unsure about but does not represent the whole.

scenario: 同样的标注预算，一个策略专挑模型最没把握的点，一个专挑能把特征空间铺得最开的点。
scenario_en: Same labeling budget: one strategy picks the model's least-confident points, the other picks points that best cover feature space.
q: 不确定性采样 vs 多样性/coreset 采样，各自的强项和盲区？
q_en: Uncertainty vs diversity/coreset sampling — each one's strength and blind spot?
why: 不确定性采样精确打在决策边界、擅长细化清晰边界，但盲区是过采离群/噪声、可能选一堆相似的难点；多样性/coreset 保证广覆盖、代表性强，但盲区是可能错过关键的边界难例。所以生产里常用 BADGE 之类混合法兼顾两者。
why_en: Uncertainty sharpens the decision boundary but oversamples outliers and near-duplicates, while diversity ensures broad coverage but can miss boundary cases, so production hybridizes them.
tradeoff: 不确定性(打边界、易过采离群/冗余) vs 多样性(广覆盖、代表性强、可能漏边界难例)
options: 两者本质相同，都是随机抽样的变体，强项盲区可以互换，没有实际区别
不确定性打边界但易过采离群/冗余；多样性广覆盖但可能漏边界难例，故常用 BADGE 混合
不确定性保证覆盖、多样性专打边界，正好和它们的名字相反
多样性采样一定优于不确定性，任何场景都该只用多样性，不确定性已被淘汰
options_en: They are essentially the same, both variants of random sampling, with interchangeable strengths and blind spots and no real difference.
Uncertainty sharpens the boundary but oversamples outliers/duplicates; diversity gives broad coverage but may miss boundary cases, so BADGE hybridizes them.
Uncertainty guarantees coverage and diversity targets the boundary, exactly the reverse of their names.
Diversity always beats uncertainty, so use only diversity everywhere; uncertainty is obsolete.
optionExplanations: 两者机制截然不同：一个看模型置信度、一个看特征空间距离，绝非随机抽样的等价变体。
对；两条轴一个抓 exploitation（打边界）一个抓 exploration（铺覆盖），各有盲区，混合法正是为同时占两头。
说反了：不确定性专打边界、多样性负责覆盖，这个选项把两者对调了。
没有普适最优——边界清晰时不确定性更省预算，冷启动缺覆盖时多样性更稳，要看场景。
optionExplanations_en: Their mechanisms differ sharply: one reads model confidence, the other feature-space distance — not equivalent variants of random sampling.
Correct — one axis exploits (sharpens the boundary) and the other explores (spreads coverage), each with a blind spot, which is why hybrids exist to grab both.
Reversed: uncertainty targets the boundary and diversity handles coverage; this option swaps them.
There is no universal winner — uncertainty saves budget when the boundary is clear, diversity is safer on a cold start lacking coverage; it depends on the scenario.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从大数据集里选出的小代表性子集，尽量保留原分布的几何覆盖。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A coreset is a small representative subset chosen to preserve the original data's geometric coverage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 探索（覆盖未知区域）与利用（打已知边界）的权衡，主动学习需兼顾。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Exploration (covering unknown regions) versus exploitation (sharpening the known boundary), a tradeoff active learning must balance.

scenario: 你想找模型「真正不知道」而不只是「概率碰巧接近 0.5」的样本，愿意多花点算力换更强的信息增益保证。
scenario_en: You want samples the model genuinely does not know, not just ones whose probability happens to be near 0.5, and will spend extra compute for stronger information-gain guarantees.
q: query-by-committee 怎么找这类样本，代价是什么？
q_en: How does query-by-committee find such samples, and at what cost?
why: 训练一个「委员会」——多个模型或用 MC dropout 造多个预测——在它们分歧最大的样本上查询。分歧大 = 高认知不确定性（epistemic，模型不知道而非数据本身噪声），信息增益保证强；代价是要跑多个模型/多次前向，算力贵。
why_en: Train a committee of models (or MC dropout) and query where they disagree most, since disagreement signals epistemic uncertainty, at the cost of running many models.
options: 只训一个模型，查询它 softmax 最接近 0.5 的样本，算力最省
训练多个模型或用 MC dropout，在它们分歧最大处查询（高认知不确定性）；代价是要跑多个模型、算力贵
随机初始化多个模型但不训练，直接看它们的原始输出分歧
只在标注者之间投票分歧的样本上查询，与模型无关
options_en: Train a single model and query where its softmax is closest to 0.5 — cheapest on compute.
Train multiple models or use MC dropout and query where they disagree most (high epistemic uncertainty), at the cost of running many models.
Randomly initialize several models without training and just look at their raw output disagreement.
Query only samples where human annotators disagree, independent of the model.
optionExplanations: 单模型 softmax≈0.5 是不确定性采样、不是 query-by-committee；后者的信号来自多个模型之间的分歧。
对；委员会分歧衡量的是认知不确定性（模型该不该知道却不知道），比单模型置信度更可信，代价就是多模型的算力。
不训练的随机模型分歧是噪声、不携带信息，委员会必须是训练过、彼此有差异的模型。
标注者分歧属于仲裁/一致性问题，query-by-committee 说的是模型委员会的分歧，两回事。
optionExplanations_en: Single-model softmax near 0.5 is uncertainty sampling, not query-by-committee, whose signal comes from disagreement across multiple models.
Correct — committee disagreement measures epistemic uncertainty (what the model should know but does not), more trustworthy than one model's confidence, at the cost of multiple models' compute.
Untrained random models disagree as noise carrying no information; the committee must be trained, mutually differing models.
Annotator disagreement is an adjudication/agreement issue; query-by-committee refers to a committee of models — a different thing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练多个模型，在它们预测分歧最大的样本上请标注，分歧=高认知不确定性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Query-by-committee trains multiple models and queries samples where they disagree most, with disagreement signaling high epistemic uncertainty.

termDefinitions.meaning: 推理时保留 dropout 多次前向，得到多个预测近似一个模型集合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MC (Monte Carlo) dropout keeps dropout on at inference and does multiple forward passes to approximate an ensemble.

termDefinitions.term: epistemic uncertainty / 认知不确定性
termDefinitions.meaning: 源于模型知识不足（多标数据可减）的不确定性，区别于数据本身的噪声。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Epistemic uncertainty comes from the model's lack of knowledge (reducible with more data), unlike inherent data noise.

scenario: 生产级主动学习，每轮要一次性选一批（batch）样本送标注，既不想全选相似的难点（冗余），也不想只图覆盖漏掉信息量。算力允许一次批选。
scenario_en: Production active learning selects a batch each round; you want neither all-similar hard points (redundant) nor coverage-only that misses information. Compute allows batch selection.
q: 该用什么方法在一批里同时兼顾不确定性和多样性？
q_en: What method balances uncertainty and diversity within one batch?
why: 用 BADGE：在梯度嵌入空间做批选择——每个样本相对当前模型的梯度，其模长编码不确定性（模型越没把握梯度越大）、方向的分散度编码多样性。在梯度嵌入上选一批既大又互相分散的点，一次性平衡 exploitation 和 exploration。
why_en: Use BADGE: batch-select on gradient embeddings where gradient magnitude encodes uncertainty and spread encodes diversity, balancing both at once.
tradeoff: BADGE(梯度嵌入同时抓不确定+多样，批选) vs 纯不确定(易选冗余难点) vs 纯多样(可能漏信息)
options: 纯 entropy 不确定性采样：每轮选熵最高的一批，简单直接
纯 coreset 多样性采样：每轮选覆盖最广的一批，保证代表性
BADGE：在梯度嵌入上批选，梯度模长=不确定性、方向分散=多样性，一次兼顾两者
随机采样：每轮均匀抽一批，避免任何选择偏差
options_en: Pure entropy uncertainty sampling: pick the highest-entropy batch each round — simple and direct.
Pure coreset diversity sampling: pick the widest-coverage batch each round to guarantee representativeness.
BADGE: batch-select on gradient embeddings where magnitude equals uncertainty and directional spread equals diversity, balancing both at once.
Random sampling: draw a uniform batch each round to avoid any selection bias.
whenOtherWins: 如果每次只标一条（不做批选）且决策边界已经清晰，单点 entropy 不确定性采样更简单也够用，不必上 BADGE。
optionExplanations: 纯 entropy 批选常挑一堆彼此相似的难点，批内冗余高、信息重复，浪费这一批的预算。
纯 coreset 只顾覆盖、不看模型没把握在哪，可能把预算花在模型早会了的区域。
对；BADGE 把不确定性（梯度模长）和多样性（梯度方向分散）统一到一个几何量里，批选天然去冗余又保信息，正是生产常用的混合法。
随机采样是基线，不利用模型状态，涨点最慢，恰是主动学习要超越的对象。
optionExplanations_en: Pure entropy batches often pick many mutually similar hard points, high intra-batch redundancy with repeated information, wasting the batch's budget.
Pure coreset only chases coverage without seeing where the model is unsure, possibly spending budget on regions already learned.

Correct — BADGE unifies uncertainty (gradient magnitude) and diversity (gradient direction spread) into one geometric quantity, so batch selection de-duplicates and preserves information — the common production hybrid.
Random sampling is the baseline that ignores model state and gains slowest, exactly what active learning aims to beat.

termDefinitions.fullName: Batch Active learning by Diverse Gradient Embeddings
termDefinitions.meaning: 在梯度嵌入空间批选样本：梯度模长表不确定性、方向分散表多样性，一举兼顾。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BADGE (Batch Active learning by Diverse Gradient Embeddings) batch-selects on gradient embeddings, where magnitude is uncertainty and spread is diversity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 样本相对当前模型参数的梯度向量，其模长与方向同时编码不确定性和样本特性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A gradient embedding is a sample's gradient w.r.t. current parameters, whose magnitude and direction jointly encode uncertainty and sample identity.

q: 把「数据飞轮」自我强化循环排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the self-reinforcing data flywheel loop correctly:
steps: 部署的模型对线上流量产出预测
用户交互产生隐式反馈（点击、纠正、停留）
主动学习从反馈里选出信息量最高的样本
选中样本经标注 + 质控，进入更新后的训练集
用更好的训练数据重训出更强的模型，再上线
why: 闭环：模型产出预测 → 用户交互给隐式反馈 → 主动学习挑信息量最高的信号 → 标注+质控进训练集 → 重训更强模型再上线，如此循环。每转一圈数据和模型都往上走，是持续改进的引擎；但每个环节都可能卡住（stall）。
why_en: The loop: model predicts, users give implicit feedback, active learning selects the most informative signals, they are labeled and QC'd into the training set, and a stronger model is retrained and redeployed.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["部署模型产出预测"] --> F["用户隐式反馈"]
  F --> A["主动学习选信息量高的"]
  A --> L["标注+质控进训练集"]
  L --> R["重训更强模型"]
  R --> M

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型→反馈→主动选样→标注→重训更强模型的自我强化循环，越转越强。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A data flywheel is the self-reinforcing loop of model to feedback to active selection to labeling to a stronger retrained model.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户行为间接透露的偏好（点击、跳过、纠正、停留），无需显式打分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Implicit feedback is preference revealed indirectly by user behavior (clicks, skips, corrections, dwell), needing no explicit rating.

scenario: 要把数据飞轮从概念落成一套可运维的生产系统，需要拆成几个各自可监控的子系统。
scenario_en: To turn the data flywheel from concept into an operable production system, you must decompose it into separately monitorable subsystems.
q: 数据飞轮落地要哪些子系统？(多选)
q_en: Which subsystems does an operational data flywheel require? (multiple)
why: 五个子系统：反馈日志、主动学习选样服务、标注路由+质控、数据版本化+训练管线、监控层（盯停滞）。每个都是独立故障域——把飞轮画成这五块，才能指出它在哪里会断，而不是一句「持续学习」带过。
why_en: The five subsystems are feedback logging, an active-learning selection service, annotation routing plus QC, data versioning plus the training pipeline, and a monitoring layer for stalls.
options: 反馈日志：捕获并存储模型预测与用户交互信号
主动学习选样服务 + 标注路由与质控
数据版本化 + 训练管线，以及盯停滞的监控层
一个把所有 GPU 超频的加速子系统，用来让飞轮转得更快
options_en: Feedback logging: capture and store model predictions and user interaction signals.
An active-learning selection service plus annotation routing and quality control.
Data versioning plus the training pipeline, and a monitoring layer that watches for stalls.
A subsystem that overclocks all GPUs to make the flywheel spin faster.
optionExplanations: 对；没有反馈日志飞轮就没有输入，捕获预测和交互信号是整个循环的起点。
对；选样服务决定标什么、路由+质控决定标得准不准，是飞轮的中段核心。
对；版本化保证可复现、训练管线出新模型、监控层盯着别让某环卡死，缺一循环就断。
错；GPU 超频是硬件把戏，不属于飞轮的数据流子系统，飞轮的瓶颈在数据与标注，不在时钟频率。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — without feedback logging the flywheel has no input; capturing predictions and interaction signals is the loop's starting point.
Correct — the selection service decides what to label and routing+QC decides how accurately, the core mid-section of the flywheel.
Correct — versioning gives reproducibility, the training pipeline produces new models, and monitoring keeps any stage from stalling; drop one and the loop breaks.
Wrong — GPU overclocking is a hardware trick, not a data-flow subsystem; the flywheel's bottleneck is data and labeling, not clock speed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给训练数据集打版本快照，保证训练可复现、可回溯是哪批数据训出哪个模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Data versioning snapshots training datasets so training is reproducible and traceable to which data produced which model.

scenario: 面试官追问：你画完这个持续学习闭环后，它可能在哪里卡死（stall）、转不动？
scenario_en: The interviewer probes: after you draw this continuous-learning loop, where can it stall and stop turning?
q: 数据飞轮的典型停滞点（stall points）有哪些？(多选)
q_en: What are typical stall points of the data flywheel? (multiple)
why: 四个常见卡点：置信度平台期（模型不再进步、选不出信息量高的样本）、标注队列瓶颈（选出来标不过来）、分布漂移打坏 labeling functions（规则失效、标签变脏）、重训失败（管线崩了新模型上不去）。能主动点名这些断点，才显出对闭环的运维理解。
why_en: Common stalls are confidence plateaus, annotation-queue bottlenecks, distribution shift breaking labeling functions, and retraining failures.
options: 置信度平台期：模型不再进步，主动学习选不出有信息量的新样本
标注队列瓶颈：选样跑得快但人工标注跟不上，积压堵死循环
分布漂移打坏 labeling functions / 重训管线失败，新模型上不了线
用户太多导致飞轮转太快，需要人为降速以免模型过热
options_en: Confidence plateau: the model stops improving and active learning can no longer surface informative new samples.
Annotation-queue bottleneck: selection runs fast but human labeling cannot keep up, and backlog jams the loop.
Distribution shift breaks labeling functions / the retraining pipeline fails so a new model cannot ship.
Too many users make the flywheel spin so fast you must artificially slow it to keep the model from overheating.
optionExplanations: 对；模型到平台期后，不确定性判据退化、选出的样本信息增益接近零，飞轮空转不再涨点。
对；主动学习再准，标注产能有上限，队列一堵、新标签进不来，循环就停在标注这一环。
对；分布一漂 labeling functions 悄悄失准、标签变脏，或重训失败让新模型卡在管线里，都是硬停滞。
错；「转太快过热」不是真实故障模式；飞轮的风险是断链和停滞，不是速度过快。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — at a plateau the uncertainty criterion degrades and selected samples have near-zero gain, so the flywheel spins without lifting performance.
Correct — however precise the selection, labeling capacity is capped; once the queue jams, new labels stop arriving and the loop halts at annotation.
Correct — drift silently misfires labeling functions and dirties labels, or a retraining failure strands the new model in the pipeline — both are hard stalls.
Wrong — 'spinning too fast and overheating' is not a real failure mode; the flywheel's risks are broken links and stalls, not excess speed.

termDefinitions.term: confidence plateau / 置信度平台期
termDefinitions.meaning: 模型性能停滞，主动学习难再找到高信息量样本，飞轮空转。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A confidence plateau is when model performance stalls and active learning can no longer find high-information samples, spinning the flywheel.

scenario: 自动驾驶车队上百万辆，要持续找出「最该拿去训练」的稀有困难场景，但不能真让新模型去开车冒风险，也没预算把每一帧都送人工。
scenario_en: A million-vehicle self-driving fleet must keep finding the rarest, hardest scenes worth training on, without letting a new model actually drive (risk) and without budget to label every frame.
q: 怎么从海量行车数据里自动挖出高价值训练样本？
q_en: How do you auto-mine high-value training samples from massive driving data?
why: 用影子模式（shadow mode）：新模型在后台对真实场景做预测但不控车，系统自动标记「模型判断与人类司机实际操作不一致」的时刻——这些分歧点就是模型还没学会的困难场景，跨百万车队自动汇聚成高价值训练样本，无需逐帧人工筛。这正是主动学习的车队级落地（Tesla Autopilot）。
why_en: Run the new model in shadow mode predicting without controlling, and auto-flag moments where its judgment disagrees with the human driver as high-value training scenes across the fleet.
tradeoff: 影子模式挖分歧(自动、安全、只挖困难样本) vs 全量人工筛(准但贵) vs 随机抽帧(便宜但多是已会的场景)
options: 让新模型直接上路控车，用它撞出来的失败案例当训练样本
随机抽取行车视频帧送人工标注，靠量大覆盖各种场景
影子模式：新模型后台预测不控车，自动标记它与人类司机操作分歧的时刻作为高价值样本
只保留模型高置信、与司机一致的片段作为训练数据，追求标签干净
options_en: Let the new model drive the car directly and use the crashes it causes as training samples.
Randomly sample driving-video frames for human annotation, relying on volume to cover scenarios.
Shadow mode: the new model predicts in the background without controlling, auto-flagging moments where it disagrees with the human driver as high-value samples.
Keep only high-confidence segments where the model agrees with the driver as training data, chasing clean labels.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务不安全攸关、且缺乏可对照的人类基准动作（没有司机操作可比），就只能退回随机抽样或人工审核来采样。
optionExplanations: 让未验证模型真控车是拿人命做实验，安全攸关系统绝不可接受，采样也不该用事故换。
随机抽帧绝大多数是模型早会了的日常路况，信息增益近零，百万车队的数据量全浪费在冗余上。
对；分歧=模型没学会的困难场景，影子模式安全地把它挑出来、跨车队自动汇聚，是主动学习在车队规模的落地。
只留一致片段等于专挑模型已会的，信息增益最低，恰好把最该学的分歧样本全丢掉了。
optionExplanations_en: Letting an unvalidated model drive experiments with human lives, unacceptable in a safety-critical system; you do not sample by trading crashes.
Random frames are mostly everyday roads the model already handles, near-zero gain, wasting the fleet's data volume on redundancy.
Correct — disagreement equals scenes the model has not learned; shadow mode safely surfaces them and auto-aggregates across the fleet, active learning at fleet scale.
Keeping only agreeing segments cherry-picks what the model already knows, the lowest gain, discarding exactly the disagreement samples most worth learning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 新模型在生产中并行预测但不接管控制，用来安全地对比它与现行系统/人类的差异。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Shadow mode runs a new model predicting in production without taking control, safely comparing it against the live system or humans.

q: 面试里被问「你怎么给这个系统搞标签」，把三层回答排成从浅到深的正确顺序：
q_en: Asked 'how would you label this system,' order the three-layer answer from shallow to deep:
steps: 按数据与预算选初始标注策略（如新审核系统 → 弱监督 bootstrap + 小专家验证集）
设计主动学习回路（边界清晰用不确定性、要广覆盖用多样性，通常混合）
画出闭环飞轮并点名它在哪里会断（置信度平台、标注队列、drift、重训失败）
why: 三层递进：先按数据/预算选初始策略（多数人只答到这层），再设计主动学习回路让标注持续升级，最后画闭环飞轮并主动指出停滞点。层层深入正是把「打标签」讲成系统、显出 senior 视角的结构。
why_en: Go deeper in three layers: pick the initial strategy by data and budget, design the active-learning loop, then draw the closed-loop flywheel and name where it breaks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在没有标签的起步阶段，用低成本手段（如弱监督）先造出第一批训练数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bootstrap means producing the first training data cheaply (e.g. weak supervision) when starting with no labels.

scenario: 你有一个 5 千条的高质量已标注种子集和 200 万条同分布的无标签数据，想低成本把训练集扩大，任务边界还算清晰。
scenario_en: You have a 5k high-quality labeled seed and 2M same-distribution unlabeled samples; you want to expand the training set cheaply, and the task boundary is fairly clear.
q: 该用哪种策略扩充数据，怎么防翻车？
q_en: Which strategy expands the data, and how do you keep it from derailing?
why: 用半监督伪标签：先用 5 千种子训模型，给无标签数据里高置信的样本打伪标签折回训练，低成本放大有效标注量。防翻车靠只信足够高置信的样本、加一致性正则、并用干净验证集每轮把关，压住 confirmation bias。
why_en: Use semi-supervised pseudo-labeling: train on the seed, fold back only high-confidence pseudo-labels, and gate each round with a clean validation set to curb confirmation bias.
tradeoff: 半监督伪标签(低成本放大标注、有 confirmation bias 风险) vs 全人工标 200 万(准但贵到不可行)
options: 把 200 万条全部送人工标注，追求最高质量，不管成本和周期
半监督伪标签：种子训模型→给高置信无标签样本打伪标签折回→靠一致性正则+干净验证集把关
自监督预训练：忽略这 5 千种子标签，纯做 pretext 任务，反正标签没用
把无标签数据无差别全部打伪标签折回，置信度不设门槛，越多越好
options_en: Send all 2M for human annotation, chasing top quality regardless of cost and timeline.
Semi-supervised pseudo-labeling: train on the seed, pseudo-label high-confidence unlabeled samples back in, gated by consistency regularization plus a clean validation set.
Self-supervised pretraining: ignore the 5k seed labels and just do a pretext task, since labels are useless anyway.
Pseudo-label all unlabeled data indiscriminately with no confidence threshold — the more the better.
whenOtherWins: 如果种子集本身太小或有偏，初始模型不可信，伪标签会系统性放大偏差，这时宁可先扩人工种子或改用弱监督。
optionExplanations: 全量人工标 200 万条成本和周期都不现实，题目正是要用小种子低成本放大，这选项否定了前提。
对；有种子集正是半监督主场——低成本扩量，但必须用置信门槛、一致性正则和验证集把关，压住确认偏差这个招牌风险。
自监督丢掉现成的高质量种子标签是浪费；这里有明确任务和种子，半监督比纯自监督更对口。
不设置信门槛会把大量错标一次性灌回，正是把 confirmation bias 点着，扩量变污染。
optionExplanations_en: Labeling all 2M by hand is unrealistic in cost and timeline; the task is precisely to amplify from a small seed cheaply, so this denies the premise.

Correct — having a seed is semi-supervision's home turf for cheap expansion, but you must gate with a confidence threshold, consistency regularization, and validation to curb its signature confirmation-bias risk.
Self-supervision wastes the ready high-quality seed labels; with a clear task and seed, semi-supervision fits better than pure self-supervision.
No confidence threshold dumps many mislabels back at once, igniting confirmation bias and turning expansion into contamination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 半监督起步用的小规模高质量已标注集，用来训出打伪标签的初始模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A seed set is the small high-quality labeled set that bootstraps semi-supervision by training the initial pseudo-labeling model.

scenario: 欺诈标注里你怀疑存在系统性错标（某类交易被一批标注者按错误指南统一标反了），想在训练前就把这些疑似错标定位并剔除。
scenario_en: In fraud labeling you suspect systematic mislabels (one transaction type consistently flipped by annotators following a bad guideline), and want to locate and remove them before training.
q: 该优先用哪种抗噪手段？
q_en: Which noise-handling method fits best?
why: 用 confident learning：它估计噪声标签与真标签的联合分布，据此定位最可能被错标的样本，在训练前剔除或改标。它直接对准「系统性错标」这类可定位的噪声，比单纯换损失函数更能把脏样本挑出来。
why_en: Use confident learning: it estimates the joint distribution of noisy and true labels to locate likely mislabels and remove them before training.
tradeoff: confident learning(定位并剔除疑似错标，治本) vs noise-robust loss(训练时降敏，不剔样本)
options: 直接加大模型容量，让网络把这些错标一并拟合掉
confident learning：估计噪声/真标签联合分布，定位并在训练前剔除疑似错标样本
什么都不做，靠早停（early stopping）自动躲开噪声记忆
对整个数据集统一做随机 label smoothing，稀释所有标签的置信度
options_en: Just increase model capacity so the network fits these mislabels away.
Confident learning: estimate the joint distribution of noisy/true labels to locate and remove likely mislabels before training.
Do nothing and rely on early stopping to auto-avoid memorizing the noise.
Apply uniform random label smoothing to the whole dataset to dilute all labels' confidence.
whenOtherWins: 如果噪声是低比率、无方向的随机翻转（对称噪声），难以逐条定位，换成 noise-robust loss 或 loss reweighting 在训练中降敏更划算。
optionExplanations: 加容量只会更彻底地背下这些系统性错标，把决策边界推得更偏，方向完全反了。
对；系统性错标是可定位的结构性噪声，confident learning 用联合分布把最可疑的样本挑出来清掉，直接治本。
早停能减轻过拟合噪声，但挡不住已经系统性偏移的边界，脏样本还在数据里。
label smoothing 均匀稀释所有标签，对准不了「某类被系统性标反」这个具体问题，还牺牲了干净样本的信号。
optionExplanations_en: More capacity only memorizes these systematic mislabels more thoroughly, pushing the boundary further off — exactly backwards.
Correct — systematic mislabels are locatable structural noise, and confident learning uses the joint distribution to pick out and clean the most suspect samples, treating the root cause.
Early stopping eases overfitting to noise but cannot undo an already systematically biased boundary; the dirty samples remain in the data.
Label smoothing uniformly dilutes all labels and cannot target 'one class systematically flipped,' while also sacrificing clean samples' signal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 估计噪声标签与真标签联合分布，定位并剔除最可能错标的样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Confident learning estimates the joint distribution of noisy and true labels to locate and remove the most likely mislabels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 one-hot 硬标签软化（如 0/1 → 0.05/0.95），降低对单一标签的过度自信。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Label smoothing softens one-hot labels (e.g. 0/1 to 0.05/0.95) to reduce overconfidence in a single label.

scenario: 团队想用自监督预训练来省下游标注成本：先在海量无标签领域数据上学通用表征，再用少量标签微调下游任务。
scenario_en: The team wants self-supervised pretraining to cut downstream labeling: learn general representations on massive unlabeled domain data, then fine-tune the downstream task with few labels.
q: 自监督预训练对下游标注成本的主要好处是什么？
q_en: What is self-supervised pretraining's main benefit for downstream labeling cost?
why: 自监督在无标签数据上学到通用表征后，下游任务只需在这个好起点上用少量标签微调就能达标，大幅削减需要人工标注的数据量——这正是「先自监督预训练、再小样本微调」成为主流范式的原因。代价是表征未必完全对口某个具体下游任务。
why_en: General representations from self-supervised pretraining let downstream tasks fine-tune with far fewer labels, slashing the amount of human annotation needed.
options: 它让下游任务彻底不需要任何标签，微调也不用标注，完全零人工
它学到通用表征作为好起点，下游只需少量标签微调即可达标，大幅削减需人工标注的数据量
它直接输出下游任务的最终标签，省掉微调这一步
它只对图像有效，对文本任务不能降低标注需求
options_en: It makes the downstream task need no labels at all — even fine-tuning requires none, fully zero-human.
It learns general representations as a strong starting point, so downstream needs only a few labels to fine-tune, sharply cutting the human-annotated data required.
It directly outputs the downstream task's final labels, skipping fine-tuning entirely.
It works only for images and cannot reduce labeling needs for text tasks.
optionExplanations: 太绝对：自监督省的是标注量、不是清零，下游微调仍需少量标签来对齐具体任务。
对；通用表征是个好底座，下游用少量标签就能微调达标，这正是自监督削减标注成本的机制。
自监督产出的是表征不是下游标签，微调这一步不能省，它给的是起点不是答案。
自监督对文本（BERT 的 MLM、GPT 的下一 token）同样有效，这句把适用范围讲窄了。
optionExplanations_en: Too absolute: self-supervision cuts labeling volume, not to zero; downstream fine-tuning still needs a few labels to align the specific task.
Correct — general representations are a strong base, so downstream fine-tunes to target with only a few labels, which is exactly how self-supervision cuts labeling cost.
Self-supervision yields representations, not downstream labels; fine-tuning cannot be skipped, as it gives a starting point, not the answer.
Self-supervision works for text too (BERT's MLM, GPT's next-token), so this understates its scope.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在预训练表征的基础上，用少量任务标签继续训练以适配具体下游任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fine-tuning continues training a pretrained representation with a few task labels to adapt it to a specific downstream task.
